profile_text.body:
Character.AI is a company founded in 2022 that operates character.ai, a chat service it describes as an AI chat app. Per its own site, users chat with millions of AI Characters, and the company markets the service with the taglines "AI Chat, Reimagined" and "Your Words. Your World." It presents itself as the number one AI chat app.

Its product, Character.ai, is a persona-based chat service. The company's own material emphasizes open-ended character conversation, and the product carries noted human-resources and appropriate-use risk.

No litigation, MCP server, or SEC or patent facts are recorded for the company.
